params.caption: 🖥️ Nvidia's board shuts the door on a Jensen Huang comeback Hours after Jensen Huang said he would accept a return as CEO, Nvidia's board has made clear the job is not on offer. The co-founder stepped down last week, and growing calls from investors, employees and politicians to reinstate him have not moved the board. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 01:33 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 👥 @nvidia 👍 Right call or mistake?
